summary: 19-year-old male trail runner went jogging near Rainbow Trout Ranch and never returned; multi-day search with air support, search dogs, and 50+ ground searchers called off August 3 after all leads exhausted. Remains recovered about a year later.
location: near Rainbow Trout Ranch, Conejos County
responding_agency: Conejos County Sheriff, AVSAR, COSAR teams
notes: Run 184 Conejos Citizen sweep: AVSAR log entry dated July 27, 2015 (missing since July 23, 2015); body found following year per CPR. SARDOC July 27-29 2015 mission report: one SARDOC dog team searched along FDR 250 near Rainbow Trout Lodge, Antonito, on 7/27 (interest along the road near the lodge, no locate); a second SARDOC team with K9 worked 9 miles along FDR 250 on 7/29 with slight interest in a couple of places, found nothing. Note: the missing subject had not been located as of December 2015.
